name: web-accordion-gallery-of-vertical-photo-strips-with-one-expanded
title: Photo accordion: thin rounded vertical strips of nature photos with one wide expanded mountain photo in the middle
whatItIs: A white frame with a horizontal row of narrow pill-shaped photo strips (sky and tree, red sail, waterfall, blue flower, building, yellow leaves, sunset) and one wide rounded photo of green mountains and cloudy sky expanded near the left.
whatItMeans: Playful and immersive; strips reveal to a full photo on hover.

vocabulary.definition: Narrow items that widen when active.
A photo cropped to a tall capsule.
The single item shown at full size.
